name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot in VS Code via 9Router extension

notes.text: Requires Cursor Pro account to use this feature.
Cursor routes requests through its own server, so local endpoint is not supported. Please enable Tunnel or Cloud Endpoint in Settings.

steps.title: Add Model Config
steps.desc: Add the following configuration to your models array:

steps.title: Install Amp
steps.desc: Install the Amp CLI using the package manager supported by your environment.

steps.title: Add Shorthands
steps.desc: Map Amp shorthand names such as g25p or cs45 to 9Router aliases in your local config.

notes.text: Use 9Router model aliases to keep Amp shorthand mappings stable across provider updates.
Suggested shorthand examples: g25p → gemini/gemini-2.5-pro, g25f → gemini/gemini-2.5-flash, cs45 → cc/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.

code.code:
export OPENAI_API_KEY="{{apiKey}}"
export OPENAI_BASE_URL="{{baseUrl}}"
amp --model "{{model}}"
# Example shorthand aliases you can map locally:
# g25p -> gemini/gemini-2.5-pro
# cs45 -> cc/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929

name: Qwen Code
description: Alibaba Qwen Code CLI — supports OpenAI, Anthropic & Gemini providers via 9Router

steps.title: Save Config
steps.desc: Copy the JSON below to your ~/.qwen/settings.json file.

notes.text: Qwen Code supports multiple provider types (openai, anthropic, gemini) via modelProviders in settings.json. 9Router works as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Any model available in 9Router can be used — not just Qwen models. Select from Qwen, Claude, Gemini, GPT, and more.
Qwen OAuth free tier was discontinued on 2026-04-15. Use 9Router with alicode/openrouter/anthropic/gemini providers instead.

name: Devin CLI
description: Cognition Devin CLI — local binary called by the Devin CLI provider via ACP/stdio

steps.title: Install Devin CLI
steps.desc: Install via the official installer at cli.devin.ai.

steps.title: Authenticate
steps.desc: Log in once so the binary stores its own credentials.

steps.title: Use the provider
steps.desc: Pick any Devin CLI model under the Providers tab — no API key field needed.

notes.text: This is a local dependency, not a routed CLI. The Devin CLI provider spawns `devin acp --agent-type summarizer` and relays its output.
Install the Devin CLI and run `devin auth login` — without it, the provider returns a spawn error on first request.

code.code:
# Install Devin CLI (see https://cli.devin.ai for options)
devin auth login

# Verify detection (optional)
devin --version

name: OpenDesign
description: OpenDesign — claude.ai/design open-sourced! Agent-native design skills pack

steps.title: Install the plugin
steps.desc: Pick your host below and run the matching install command from the matrix.

steps.title: No config needed
steps.desc: OpenDesign runs inside your host agent and uses its model config. If the host already routes through 9Router, /opendesign traffic does too.

steps.title: Start designing
steps.value: /opendesign make a pitch deck for a seed-stage AI company, 10 slides

notes.text: OpenDesign ships as a plugin/skills pack installed into Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, or OpenCode. It inherits the host agent's model config, so once your host points at 9Router, /opendesign design sessions route through 9Router automatically — no extra env vars needed.
Invoke with /opendesign <brief>. Covers decks, wireframes, interactive prototypes, design-system extraction, and brand systems, with a verifier subagent that checks output against the brief.

code.code:
# Claude Code
/plugin marketplace add manalkaff/opendesign
/plugin install opendesign@opendesign

# Cursor
/add-plugin opendesign

# OpenAI Codex CLI
/plugins   # search "opendesign" -> Install Plugin

# OpenAI Codex App
# Plugins sidebar -> OpenDesign (Design section) -> +

# Gemini CLI
gemini extensions install https://github.com/manalkaff/opendesign

# OpenCode
# Fetch and follow .opencode/INSTALL.md from the repo
